notes.title: Hakuoki: Edo Blossoms Now Available on Steam with a Weeklong 30% Discount and a Deluxe Pack!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31846719/7ea7cbae7b17ab3f24c58c22f438470aa52c2779.png

Your best boy is ready! Hakuoki™: Edo Blossoms is OUT NOW for Steam with English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles! The game launches with a 30% weeklong discount and a Deluxe Pack!

The Deluxe Pack includes:
- "Character Art Collection" Art Book
- "Event Scene Collection" Art Book
- 4 PC Wallpapers
- 12 Mobile Wall Papers

The Steam version of the game also includes a permanent 10% discount on the following bundles: 

Deluxe Bundle (the game + Deluxe Pack items)
 DLC Bundle (the game + DLC content)
 Complete Deluxe Set (the game + DLC + Deluxe Pack items)
Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms Bundle

The weeklong 30% launch discount allows you to purchase the game for just $20.99 (original price is $29.99)! The Deluxe Bundle (the game + Deluxe Pack items) will be discounted at $27.88 and the Complete Deluxe Set (the game + DLC + Deluxe Pack items) for $30.58 with launch discount! Haven’t played Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds yet? No worries! We also have a Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms Bundle available for $50.98 with the launch discount.

notes.title: Hakuoki: Edo Blossoms comes to Steam on March 13 with a 30% weeklong discount and a Deluxe Pack DLC!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31846719/31fb7a56b8f6064fb1abd71ffb6539e8f085bf07.png

Hakuoki™: Edo Blossoms hits Steam, March 13, with a Deluxe Pack and English, Japanese, and traditional Chinese subtitles!
The Steam version of the game releases in tandem with the PlayStation®Vita/PlayStation®TV North American version. The European version for the PS Vita will release on March 16, 2018.

The game will launch with a 30% weeklong discount for the main game, a Deluxe Pack DLC, which includes the "Character Art Collection" and "Event Scene Collection" art books, 4 PC wallpapers, and 12 mobile wallpapers, and lastly, 10% permanent discounts for the following bundles:

- Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack DLC)
- DLC Bundle (Game + Blossoms Treasure Box DLC)
- Complete Deluxe Set (Game + Deluxe Pack DLC + Blossoms 
Treasure Box DLC)
- Hakuoki: Kyoto Winds + Edo Blossoms Bundle
